posthoc_interface_audit.prompt_parser_ambiguity: Prompts displayed sentence IDs inside square brackets while validation required the unwrapped ID string; the output instruction did not explicitly illustrate that distinction.
posthoc_interface_audit.interpretation: The observed aggregate decline is driven by validity-discordant pairs, not demonstrated deterioration among valid answer pairs. This decomposition is descriptive and post-treatment, not an alternative efficacy estimate. No wrapper removal, field insertion, rescoring replacement or output retry was applied. Question-only performance is too format-limited to diagnose memorization.

metric_policy: Prespecified all-planned pipeline metrics: invalid complete outputs receive zero, not repaired or discarded. Agents are averaged within question; controls are not compute matched.

bootstrap.interpretation: Unadjusted descriptive intervals, not confirmatory tests or equivalence evidence.

dedup_baseline: Exact source-sentence dedup yields the once prompt/seed by construction. Alias with zero extra calls; not an independent measured arm or method novelty.

measured_resources.billing_note: Observed process/API durations are not a rental invoice. Idle time, setup, downloads and verification are not included in inference elapsed time. No estimated or inflated expense is reported as measured.

verification.software_fixture_note: Software fixture outputs are not scientific observations. A development-time concurrent source edit caused an earlier source-integrity test failure; after freezing, the complete 138-test rerun passed.

decision: No automatic additional inference. Resolve the identified displayed-ID versus parser interface ambiguity before a separately frozen fresh-question diagnostic, without repairing this batch. This small diagnostic does not establish systematic repetition harm, DICE efficacy, statistical independence, or useful computation reuse. Single-union had higher observed mean utility; retain this unfavorable comparison.
raw_data_policy: Raw requests, responses, gold, candidate contexts, source snapshot and logs are retained in private local backup, not uploaded to the public repository.
